transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been having a really hard time focusing and paying attention lately. It feels almost impossible to stay focused on tasks, even simple ones, for more than a few minutes.
Have you struggled with these attention and focus issues since you were a child, or is this a relatively new problem for you?

Honestly, I've struggled with these focus issues since I was a kid, definitely before I turned 12. It's not a new thing, but it has become a major struggle and much more noticeable over the last nine months.
Along with these focus issues, do you often feel restless, fidgety, or have trouble sitting still, both now and when you were younger?
No, I don't really experience restlessness, fidgeting, or any trouble sitting still. My struggles have always been strictly about my focus and keeping my attention on things.
Over the last nine months, have you also been experiencing a consistently low mood, or a loss of interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy?
No, I haven't really had a low mood or lost interest in things I enjoy. My struggles are definitely more about my focus and actually finishing tasks, rather than my mood.
Over the last several months, have you been experiencing excessive, uncontrollable worry or anxiety about various everyday things, like work, health, or minor matters?
No, I don't really experience excessive or uncontrollable worry or anxiety. I might get a little stressed when I struggle to finish a task, but it's not a constant anxiety about everyday life.
